name: Lista USD
oneLiner: lisUSD is Lista DAO's BNB Chain stablecoin; the CDP that mints it is winding down by 2026-10-31 as positions move to Lista Lending.
collateral: BNB, ETH, liquid-staking tokens, BTCB and additional issuer-listed GemJoin assets support CDPs. Issuer PSM documentation names USDT and USDC for nominal 1:1 minting; FDUSD is separately listed as CDP collateral. D3M is a distinct credit-based direct-deposit exposure.
pegMechanism: PSM enabling 1:1 swaps with centralized stablecoins; CDP overcollateralization and liquidation

notices.title: Do not deposit slisBNB in temporary migration CDP
notices.message: Lista DAO keeps a temporary CDP market open only for partner migration after the legacy lisUSD CDP sunset. Holders should not deposit slisBNB into that temporary CDP market; use Lista Lending or the PSM instead.

notices.title: Legacy lisUSD CDP sunset completed
notices.message: Lista DAO retired legacy lisUSD CDPs on October 31, 2026 and settled remaining user positions by November 16, while lisUSD continues in Lista Lending and the PSM.
